testCases.name: SDK Preload Check
testCases.validationLogic: Parse 'loaded=N' from SDK loader output, verify N > 0

testCases.name: Provider Initialization Check
testCases.validationLogic: Verify no ProviderInitError in output, response received

testCases.name: RPC API Service Connectivity
testCases.validationLogic: curl endpoint, verify response contains 'status' or 'ok'

testCases.name: SurrealDB Service Connectivity
testCases.validationLogic: curl endpoint, verify no connection refused

testCases.name: Environment Variables Check
testCases.validationLogic: Check process.env for both keys, verify non-empty

testCases.name: Config File API Key Substitution
testCases.validationLogic: Read config file, verify 'sk-ant-' present and no '${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}' placeholders

testCases.name: Activity List Command
testCases.validationLogic: Run command, verify output contains 'template' or 'activity' and no errors
